newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech NPF bills gross 11.6 pct, oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Czech NPF bills gross 11.6 pct, oversubscribed.

text.p: Gross yield in a Dutch auction on Wednesday of 22-week Czech National Property Fund (NPF) bills was 11.6 percent, the Czech National Bank said.

The offer of 2.5 billion crowns to the market was oversubscribed with bids totalling 5.175 billion crowns. Accepted bids were shortened to 76 percent of all bids at 11.6 percent gross yield, the CNB said.
The NPF is the privatisation agency of the Czech government which manages state-held shares in Czech companies.
